description: pkix-profiles/src/lib.rs web_pki_missing_san_rejected() (line 325): This test name implies SAN rejection is verified, but the actual test code (lines 345-351) uses webpki-self-signed-365d.der which HAS a SAN, and asserts that it PASSES (not that it's rejected). The comment on lines 332-343 acknowledges the workaround: 'this test validates that web_pki_policy returns require_subject_alt_name=true' — which is just a field-value assertion, not the rejection test the name implies. The rejection path for MissingSan error is tested in pkix-path/src/lib.rs tests_policy_fields::require_san_fails_when_san_absent (which uses leaf-p256-365d-no-san.der). The misnamed test in pkix-profiles could mislead reviewers into thinking the rejection case is covered here when it's only partially covered. Either rename the test to 'web_pki_policy_san_field_is_true' or add a fixture without SAN and test actual rejection.
title: web_pki_policy missing_san test misleadingly named and doesn't test rejection
